name: ah-repowise-health
description: RepoWise index health check using the bounded entry point only. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

steps.prompt: For {{repository}}: report RepoWise index freshness, symbol and file counts and any health warnings from existing RepoWise status output. Read-only. Do not run bare repowise update or any hook. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Only if {{previous.output}} reports a stale index, refresh it via packages/repowise/scripts/Invoke-RepoWiseBoundedIndex.ps1 and report before and after counts. Nothing else. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.
